alarms.action: Sets latched alarm M290, aborts cycle to VENT (M205), asserts FAIL (M211), and lights fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: Test pressure (14.50 kPa) not reached within fill timeout period (T21, 8.0 s) during FILL (M202)
alarms.name: Fill timeout (M290)

alarms.action: Sets latched alarm M291, opens vent valve XV-2004 (Y22), closes fill valve XV-2002, aborts sequence to VENT with FAIL result, and lights fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: PT-2001 pack pressure D100 exceeds overpressure limit D123 (20.00 kPa / K2000)
alarms.name: Over-pressure (M291)

alarms.action: Activates unlatched alarm M292, inhibits cycle start, prevents transition to UNCLAMP holding vent open, and triggers fault summary M299 / beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: PT-2001 reading D100 falls below -5.00 kPa (K-500) indicating wire break
alarms.name: PT-2001 signal fault (M292)

alarms.action: Sets latched alarm M293, aborts cycle to VENT (M205) with FAIL result (M211), and lights fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: Supply air pressure switch PS-2009 (X22) lost while station is busy (M200)
alarms.name: Supply air low (M293)

interlocks.cause: Clamp not confirmed closed (ZS-2002A / X20 lost or ZS-2002B / X21 made)
interlocks.effect: Fill valve XV-2003 (Y21) cannot open and closes immediately.

interlocks.cause: ST20 fault active (M299) or E-stop lost (X0)
interlocks.effect: Fill valve XV-2003 (Y21) inhibited; active test aborts to VENT (M205) with FAIL result (M211).

interlocks.cause: Overpressure condition detected (PT-2001 / D100 > D123, 20.00 kPa)
interlocks.effect: Fill valve XV-2003 closed, vent valve XV-2004 (Y22) held open, FAIL result latched.

interlocks.cause: Pack pressure not below 1.00 kPa or PT-2001 signal fault (M292)
interlocks.effect: Unclamp inhibited; station held in VENT with vent valve held open.
New cycle start inhibited if pallet sensor drops and returns.

interlocks.cause: Manual vent pushbutton (PB-2010 / X25) pressed while not in auto mode (ANI X2)

steps.entry: Pallet in position rising edge (ZS-2008 / X23), Auto mode (SS-0003 / X2), no active ST20 fault (ANI M299), station idle (ANI M200).
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed closed (ZS-2002A / X20) and clamp open clear (ANI ZS-2002B / X21).
steps.name: CLAMP (M201)

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed closed and clamp open clear.
steps.exit: PT-2001 pressure reaching fill completion threshold (D100 >= D122, 14.50 kPa) OR fill timeout (T21, 8.0 s) / fault trip.
steps.name: FILL (M202)

steps.entry: Test window complete (T23) OR fault trip during busy state (M299 AND M200).
steps.exit: Vent time elapsed (0.5 s), pressure below 1.00 kPa (D100 < K100), and PT-2001 healthy (ANI M292).
steps.name: VENT (M205)

steps.entry: Vent condition met (vent timer done, D100 < 1.00 kPa, PT-2001 healthy).
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed open (ZS-2002B / X21) and clamp closed clear (ANI ZS-2002A / X20).
steps.name: UNCLAMP (M206)

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed open (ZS-2002B / X21 and ANI ZS-2002A / X20).
steps.exit: Pallet leaves test position (ANI ZS-2008 / X23).
steps.name: DONE (M207)
